description: An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server providing access to UAS drone regulations from EASA, UK CAA, US FAA, and Italian ENAC. Search articles, browse regulations, compare authorities, and sync to Azure SQL — through any MCP-compatible AI client.
releaseNotes: v3.0 — Multi-authority support (EASA, UK CAA, US FAA, ENAC). Fix critical infinite loop in chunker. Robust PDF ingestion with probe/timeout for image-heavy files. Azure SQL sync command. 80+ regulations indexed.
title: 120mAGL MCP Server - UAS Drone Regulations (EASA, CAA, FAA)
